limitations: Residual is non-P host wall cost, not pure D or an all-rank worst-case bound.
Late host abort eligibility relies on the recorded producer learning rejection.
Replay covers the residual cache only when no residual entries were evicted.
P and solo-D cache histories are not independently reconstructed.
Quota arithmetic using recorded solo D is not a counterfactual latency result.
v1/v2 diagnostic stage timing and cache histories can differ; cohort summaries are not matched performance trials.
A quota advantage may be absent; complete lifecycle checks do not imply improvement.
